coverTitle:
Five Prayers
For When You're
Still Waiting
coverDek: For the job, the healing, the spouse, the answer that hasn't come yet — five ways to pray while you wait.

points.hook: Lord, teach me to wait without turning bitter in the waiting.
paragraphs: I don't know yet how this season ends, and the not-knowing is its own kind of weight. Teach me to wait the way a farmer waits for rain — expecting something, not just enduring nothing.
points.verseText: They that wait upon the LORD shall renew their strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles.

points.hook: This season is not punishment. It is preparation — and I decree it will not outlast its purpose!
paragraphs: I refuse to let delay convince me I've been forgotten. What God promised is still coming, right on time, and not one day late. I will not quit one season before the breakthrough!
points.verseText: Though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.

points.hook: Lord, my body is tired of hoping and bracing at the same time.
paragraphs: My shoulders are tight from carrying a question I can't put down, and I keep checking for news that hasn't come. Let my body learn what my spirit is trying to believe — that it's safe to rest even before the answer arrives.
points.verseText: Be still, and know that I am God.

points.hook: We stand with you in this waiting room, and we will not let you wait alone.
paragraphs: Whatever you are waiting on, you don't have to carry it by yourself tonight — we are praying it with you, not just for you. The family of God does not leave anyone waiting alone.
points.verseText: Bear ye one another's burdens, and so fulfil the law of Christ.

points.hook: My child, I see every day you've marked off the calendar, and I have not forgotten you.
paragraphs: I know the thoughts I think toward you, and not one of them is evil. Keep trusting Me through what feels like silence — the end I have planned for you is good, and it is coming.
points.verseText: For I know the thoughts that I think toward you, saith the LORD, thoughts of peace, and not of evil, to give you an expected end.

cta.closingLine: If this spoke to you, let's stay connected.
